start: Chrome on the desk phone, app.mettleup.fit signed in, internet on

steps.action: Open app.mettleup.fit and tap Install app in Chrome's menu
user_sees: Chrome's Install app sheet with the MettleUp admin icon
must_not: No install offer (the service worker did not take the page)

steps.action: Open the installed app once with internet
user_sees: The admin app opens on the newest version
must_not: An old version shown while the newest is online

steps.action: Turn internet off and open the installed app again
user_sees: The admin app opens and shows the copy of the gym kept on this device
must_not: Chrome's dinosaur page
A blank white screen
Old buttons from a previous deploy that no longer work

start: Alerts on for this browser, the admin app closed

steps.action: A member sends a complaint; the gym server sends an alert
user_sees: A phone or computer notice, for example 'MettleUp: news from your members'
must_not: The same alert shown twice (open page and closed app)
Another gym's alert

steps.action: Tap the notice
user_sees: The admin app opens on that alert's page; an open tab is reused
must_not: A second admin app tab when one is already open
A page outside the admin app

start: Settings, Alerts from your members, this device signed up for alerts

steps.action: Tap Send a test alert
user_sees: A test notice on this device
The alerts card says when it showed, for example 'It showed on this device at 7:41 pm'
must_not: The card never saying it showed although the notice appeared
The test reaching another device

start: A new phone that never opened the admin app, no internet

steps.action: Open app.mettleup.fit with no internet
user_sees: The browser's own no-internet page
must_not: A half-drawn admin app
A copy of another person's gym

steps.action: On the installed app with no internet, open a join link app.mettleup.fit/j/ABC123
user_sees: The browser's no-internet page (join, check-in and legal pages are never kept)
must_not: The admin app opening in place of the join page

start: The installed app used offline yesterday; a new version was deployed today

steps.action: Open the installed app with internet
user_sees: The new version, without a reload by hand
must_not: Yesterday's version kept on screen while online

steps.action: Turn internet off and open it again
user_sees: Today's version from the device copy
must_not: Files of the old version mixed in
A blank page because an old file was dropped

start: A shared desk computer with the installed admin app

steps.action: Sign out on the shared computer, then open the installed app with no internet
user_sees: The sign-in screen; no gym copy
must_not: The previous person's gym data shown offline
Members' names readable without a sign-in
